# Schedule dates are computed by code, not generated by the LLM

Node dates come from a deterministic engine that applies the rule base and historical node statistics. The LLM only reads the TP, classifies tech level and risks, and explains the result. We chose this because managers must be able to ask why a date is what it is and get the same answer twice; letting the LLM produce dates directly would be quicker to build but unrepeatable and hard to debug.
